blocks.x: Yeah, well, o.k. I think what we’ll do is take a pause for now until tomorrow, and we’ll finish up then.
It couldn’t have been stated any better. Thank you very much for your time.
You’re an excellent interviewer. I think you’re doing a great job.
Well thank you. You say nice things.
You’ve got all your . . . you’ve got your act together. You’ve got everything written down. And here I’m babbling away.
Ah well. Sixty percent of the questions have come from your comments. These are just to get me started.
